items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: I have a kid I just recorded, Chris Ruggiero

ctx.x: I think it does, and it’s all worked for you. And I want to thank you for your time today. It’s enlightening and I know people are going to dig it.

Well one of the things I’m glad took place with this interview, you didn’t ask me about any of the records and how do you go about doing this, how do you go about doing that, but some of the things that I’m more proud of that I’ve done recently, if you get a chance to actually get a chance to listen, I mentioned a Ronnie Milsap record – I did that twenty years ago but I still love the arrangements I wrote on Ronnie’s record. I only wrote six of the arrangements. I split the date with Sammy Nestico, which was a…

that some of the arrangements in that were – they’re all old pop tunes, but some of the arrangements were very, very cleverly constructed and we went through a process working with a couple of people that fed ideas into it and it’s all explained on the record. But the most joy has been over the past years not chasing the market but just writing what I really wanted to write.
